lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਬੇਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਅਮੁਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)dar sughaR sujaan betaa gun govi(n)d amuliaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord of the Universe is beautiful, proficient, wise and all-knowing;

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਭਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaag paaiaa dukh gavaaiaa bhaee pooran aas jeeu ||
lines.translation: His Virtues are priceless. By great good fortune, I have found Him; my pain is dispelled, and my hopes are fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak saran teree mitee jam kee traas jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, I have entered Your Sanctuary, Lord, and my fear of death is eradicated. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਮੁਈ ਕਰਤੀ ਕਰਮ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat bin bhram muee karatee karam anek ||
lines.translation: Without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one dies wandering around in confusion, performing all sorts of rituals.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਮਲ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਾਧੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮਹਿ ਲੇਖ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: komal ba(n)dhan baadheeaa naanak karamahi lekh ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, all are bound by the attractive bonds of Maya, and the karmic record of past actions. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਭਾਣੇ ਸੇ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਭੀ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo bhaane se meliaa vichhoRe bhee aap ||
lines.translation: Those who are pleasing to God are united with Him; He separates others from Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee jaa kaa vad parataap ||2||
lines.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God; His greatness is glorious! ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰੀਖਮ ਰੁਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਜੇਠ ਅਖਾੜੈ ਘਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: greekham rut at gaakhaRee jeth akhaaRai ghaam jeeu ||
lines.translation: In the summer season, in the months of Jayt'h and Asaarh, the heat is terrible, intense and severe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹੁ ਦੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਕਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: prem bichhohu duhaaganee drisat na karee raam jeeu ||
lines.translation: The discarded bride is separated from His Love, and the Lord does not even look at her.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਆਵੈ ਮਰਤ ਹਾਵੈ ਮਹਾ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਮੁਠੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: nah drisat aavai marat haavai mahaa gaarab mutheeaa ||
lines.translation: She does not see her Lord, and she dies with an aching sigh; she is defrauded and plundered by her great pride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਬਾਝੁ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਤੜਫੜਾਵੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੁਠੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal baajh machhulee taRaphaRaavai sa(n)g maaiaa rutheeaa ||
lines.translation: She flails around, like a fish out of water; attached to Maya, she is alienated from the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਪਾਪ ਜੋਨੀ ਭੈ ਭੀਤ ਹੋਈ ਦੇਇ ਸਾਸਨ ਜਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar paap jonee bhai bheet hoee dei saasan jaam jeeu ||
lines.translation: She sins, and so she is fearful of reincarnation; the Messenger of Death will surely punish her.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਓਟ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak ot teree raakh pooran kaam jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, take me under Your sheltering support, Lord, and protect me; You are the Fulfiller of desire. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਗੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੈ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saradhaa laagee sa(n)g preetamai ik til rahan na jaai ||
lines.translation: With loving faith, I am attached to my Beloved; I cannot survive without Him, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: man tan a(n)tar rav rahe naanak sahaj subhaai ||1||
lines.translation: He is permeating and pervading my mind and body, O Nanak, with intuitive ease. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੀ ਸਾਜਨਹਿ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar gahi leenee saajanahi janam janam ke meet ||
lines.translation: My Friend has taken me by the hand; He has been my best friend, lifetime after lifetime.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨਹ ਦਾਸੀ ਕਰਿ ਲਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਿਤ ਚੀਤ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: charanah daasee kar laee naanak prabh hit cheet ||2||
lines.translation: He has made me the slave of His feet; O Nanak, my consciousness is filled with love for God. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੁਤਿ ਬਰਸੁ ਸੁਹੇਲੀਆ ਸਾਵਣ ਭਾਦਵੇ ਆਨੰਦ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: rut baras suheleeaa saavan bhaadave aana(n)d jeeu ||
lines.translation: The rainy season is beautiful; the months of Saawan and Bhaadon bring bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਣ ਉਨਵਿ ਵੁਠੇ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghan unav vuthe jal thal pooriaa makara(n)d jeeu ||
lines.translation: The clouds are low, and heavy with rain; the waters and the lands are filled with honey.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਠਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh poor rahiaa sarab thaaee har naam nav nidh grih bhare ||
lines.translation: God is all-pervading everywhere; the nine treasures of the Lord's Name fill the homes of all hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹਾ ਸਭਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: simar suaamee a(n)tarajaamee kul samoohaa sabh tare ||
lines.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord and Master, the Searcher of hearts, all one's ancestry is saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਨਹ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਲਾਗੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸਦ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pri ra(n)g jaage nah chhidr laage kripaal sad bakhasi(n)d jeeu ||
lines.translation: No blemish sticks to that being who remains awake and aware in the Love of the Lord; the Merciful Lord is forever forgiving.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak har ka(n)t paaiaa sadaa man bhaava(n)d jeeu ||4||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, I have found my Husband Lord, who is forever pleasing to my mind. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਮੈ ਫਿਰਉ ਕਬ ਪੇਖਉ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: aas piaasee mai phirau kab pekhau gopaal ||
lines.translation: Thirsty with desire, I wander around; when will I behold the Lord of the World?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hai koee saajan sa(n)t jan naanak prabh melanahaar ||1||
lines.translation: Is there any humble Saint, any friend, O Nanak, who can lead me to meet with God? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin milabe saa(n)t na oopajai til pal rahan na jaai ||
lines.translation: Without meeting Him, I have no peace or tranquility; I cannot survive for a moment, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧਹ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har saadhah saranaagatee naanak aas pujaai ||2||
lines.translation: Entering the Sanctuary of the Lord's Holy Saints, O Nanak, my desires are fulfilled. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੁਤਿ ਸਰਦ ਅਡੰਬਰੋ ਅਸੂ ਕਤਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: rut sarad ada(n)baro asoo katake har piaas jeeu ||
lines.translation: In the cool, autumn season, in the months of Assu and Katik, I am thirsty for the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜੰਤੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਫਿਰਤ ਕਬ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: khoja(n)tee darasan phirat kab mileeai gunataas jeeu ||
lines.translation: Searching for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, I wander around wondering, when will I meet my Lord, the treasure of virtue?

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਹ ਸੂਖ ਸਾਰੇ ਹਾਰ ਕੰਙਣ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਬਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin ka(n)t piaare nah sookh saare haar ka(n)ngan dhrig banaa ||
lines.translation: Without my Beloved Husband Lord, I find no peace, and all my necklaces and bracelets become cursed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਸੁਜਾਣਿ ਚਤੁਰਿ ਬੇਤੀ ਸਾਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਤਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)dar sujaan chatur betee saas bin jaise tanaa ||
lines.translation: So beautiful, so wise, so clever and knowing; still, without the breath, it is just a body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਉਤ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਅਲੋਕਨ ਮਨਿ ਮਿਲਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: eet ut dah dis alokan man milan kee prabh piaas jeeu ||
lines.translation: I look here and there, in the ten directions; my mind is so thirsty to meet God!

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak dhaar kirapaa melahu prabh gunataas jeeu ||5||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, shower Your Mercy upon me; unite me with Yourself, O God, O treasure of virtue. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਣਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jalan bujhee seetal bhae man tan upajee saa(n)t ||
lines.translation: The fire of desire is cooled and quenched; my mind and body are filled with peace and tranquility.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਭ੍ਰਾਂਤਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak prabh pooran mile duteeaa binasee bhraa(n)t ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, I have met my Perfect God; the illusion of duality is dispelled. ||1||
